title: Follow-the-sun on-call
transcript:
[00:00] Petra: The on-call survey is in. People in London are getting paged at three in the morning for US traffic.
[00:08] Andile: Follow-the-sun fixes that. London covers the day here, Austin covers the day there.
[00:14] Mei: Austin has two people who know the payment system. That's not enough for a rotation.
[00:21] Andile: We train more. It's six weeks of shadowing.
[00:25] Mei: Six weeks where incidents take longer. I'm not comfortable with that before the holiday peak.
[00:32] Petra: Both fair. I don't want to force a decision now.
[00:37] Andile: Can we at least start the shadowing?
[00:41] Mei: Shadowing alone I'm fine with.
[00:45] Petra: OK. Andile, set up shadowing for two Austin engineers. The rotation itself we leave open until January.
[00:53] Andile: Will do.
